name: Seamus O'Connell
bio:
Seamus O'Connell's journey into motorsport logistics was, as he puts it, 'a happy accident.' Starting his career as a freight dispatcher in Dublin, he handled increasingly complex and time-sensitive shipments, eventually catching the eye of a smaller rally team looking for someone to manage their European transport. From there, he was hooked. Seamus thrives on the logistical puzzles inherent in motorsport, meticulously planning routes, managing customs, and ensuring equipment arrives on time, every time. 

His calm and pragmatic approach has earned him the respect of teams throughout the paddock. While others might panic under pressure, Seamus methodically works through challenges, drawing on his years of experience and a vast network of contacts. He's not one for grand pronouncements or innovative solutions; instead, he focuses on the fundamentals, ensuring the team's operations run smoothly and efficiently. His ability to see the big picture while managing the smallest details is invaluable to Akkodis ASP Team. He prides himself on anticipating problems before they arise, making him a highly sought-after logistics coordinator.

Seamus is known for his unwavering dedication to the team. He often arrives early and stays late, ensuring everything is in place for the next day's activities. His colleagues appreciate his willingness to help, his dry wit, and his ability to defuse tense situations with a well-timed joke. Seamus is the steady hand that keeps Akkodis ASP Team moving forward.

physical.description: A stout man with a ruddy complexion, Seamus always seems to have a twinkle in his eye.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Jane's Fighting Ships' in his briefcase.
Insists on brewing his own strong Irish tea in the office.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically on his desk when deep in thought.
